Title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova et amplissima collectio, tomus undecimus (reproduction en fac-simile pour H. Welter)
Creator: Conciliar acts, 7th century, edited by Giovanni Domenico Mansi (the 1901 Welter facsimile)
Publisher: Paris: H. Welter (facsimile of Mansi's collection), 1901
Publication Date: 1901 (host date; the title page names the Welter facsimile)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1901); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item sacrorumconcilio0000vari_m7f6, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-10 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (3,389,822) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1901, out of US copyright by date. SCAN QUALITY: second witness only; quote only after checking the passage against the scanned page. Long-s Latin readable; the Greek columns are poor. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: The councils of the later seventh century, the Third Council of Constantinople (680-681) chief among them. In its eleventh session, Sophronius of Jerusalem's synodical letter of 634 to Sergius of Constantinople is read, at about OCR lines 44625-44660 ('Domino in omnibus sanctissimo ... Sergio archiepiscopo et patriarchae Constantinopoleos'), with a second Sophronius text at about 44703. The volume ends with the life of Pope Conon (686-687) at about 106763.
